title: Stained Glass Cosmic Selfie
description: A woman in a white and purple bikini sits on a bed taking a selfie with her smartphone. She is framed within an intricate stained glass window featuring a glowing sunrise at the top, swirling galaxies, floating crystals, and orange flowers on the sides, with a cosmic portal vortex visible in the mirror's reflection.
prompt: A beautiful woman with long wavy lavender hair wearing a white and purple string bikini sits on a messy bed inside a large arched stained glass window. She holds a smartphone taking a selfie while looking at her reflection. The stained glass depicts a radiant sun at the top, swirling galaxies with stars and nebulae on both sides, floating dark crystals, and orange flowers at the bottom corners. A glowing blue magical energy portal swirls in the mirror reflection, surreal fantasy style, highly detailed, vibrant colors
